-- a question is JSON or a file. The options ride inside
-- it, so the last argument is NULL: billing, shipping,
-- and account
SELECT body, thinkthen_choose(
    '{"choose": "Which team owns this?",
      "options": ["billing", "shipping", "account"]}',
    body, NULL) AS team
FROM (VALUES
    ('I was billed twice for one order.'),
    ('My parcel is a week late.'),
    ('I am locked out of my account.')) AS t(body);
